prompt: Photorealistic portrait poster of an elderly Kenyan man at a community gathering, warm documentary photograph style, natural light, include a headline

plan.rationale: For this photorealistic portrait of an elderly Kenyan man at a community gathering, we'll aim for a warm, documentary-style photograph to evoke a sense of community and authenticity. The portrait will be set in natural light to create a natural and unforced feel. The headline 'Elder Wisdom' will be placed prominently above the image to capture the essence of the subject's experience and the significance of his presence at the gathering. We'll keep the palette restrained, using earthy tones to reflect the setting and the subject's heritage. The composition will be simple, with a single, strong element: the elderly man standing proudly among others, symbolizing the wisdom he brings to the community. The margin will be clean and uncluttered, allowing the focus to remain on the man and the scene.

elements.image_prompt: A single, bold font written in a clean, modern style, positioned above the portrait. The text should be legible and impactful.

elements.content: A warm, documentary-style photograph of an elderly Kenyan man standing among a group of people at a community gathering. The man is depicted in natural light, with a gentle smile and a sense of pride in his demeanor. The background shows a simple, local setting with minimal distractions.
elements.image_prompt: An elderly Kenyan man in a traditional garment, standing confidently among a diverse group of people at a community gathering. The setting is a natural outdoor space with a clear sky and warm sunlight. The man is center stage, with subtle shadows and highlights to enhance the realism and depth of the scene.
